Name: Maggs Sebastian Eats Tortillas Instead of Smoking
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Just a silly mod that replaces Sebastian's smoking animation with eating a tortilla. Carbs are better than cigarettes, right? It also replaces the radio (vanilla) or vase (SVE) in his room with a plate of tortillas and updates the tile interaction line.

Sprites included for vanilla, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30023]Maggs Emo Sebastian Portraits and Sprites[/url].

[b]Screenshots feature[/b]
Sebastian's room from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25841]Maggs Immersive Sebastian[/url]
